summary: One key of a work item's context was set, changed or removed; a change of several keys writes one line for each.

old.description: The key's value before the change, in whatever shape the person or agent gave it; null when the key was not there.

new.description: The key's value after the change, in whatever shape the person or agent gave it; null both when it was set to null and when it was removed, which the context itself tells apart.
